prompt: Some people think that all advertising aimed at children under the age of twelve should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the modern world, the children are watching a lot of the advertisements on the television, on the internet and even inside the games. Some people believe that all the advertising for the children under twelve years old must be forbidden. I completely agree with this opinion, because the children are not able to understand the advertising.

Firstly, a small child can not understand that the advertisement wants to sell something. He thinks it is only a funny video or a part of the program. Because of this, the companies are taking the advantage of the children, and this is not fair. An adult can decide if he wants to buy or not, but a child can not decide this.

Secondly, the advertising causes many problems in the family. The children see the toys or the sweets on the screen and after that they ask their parents to buy them. If the parents say no, the child becomes angry and cry. In the poor families this is a bigger problem, because the parents can not buy the expensive things and they feel bad.

Moreover, most of the advertisements for the children are about the unhealthy food, like the sweets, the chocolates and the fast food. This is one of the reason of the childhood obesity which is increasing in many countries.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that the advertising to the children under twelve should be banned completely, because the children can not understand it, it makes the problems in the family and it is bad for their health.
title: Advertising aimed at young children
